newsitem.title: USA: Synaptix purchases assets and name.
newsitem.headline: Synaptix purchases assets and name.

text.p: Synaptix Systems Corp, the new name of Basic Natural Resources Inc, said Wednesday it purchased the company name and three software programs from Synaptix Systems Corp, a Florida corporation, on May 30.
The new Synaptix acquired the assets for 3,000,000 shares of its common stock.
In anticipation of the closing, the company said it changed its name to Synaptix on April 9.

Synaptix is a computer software company engaged in the development of mobile wireless communications software which provide wireless data exchange between the mobile user and corporate database systems.
